                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/shenchuanchao/p/19165809" title="发布于 2025-10-25 18:24">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">ASP.NET Core Blazor简介和快速入门三（布局和路由）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<span data-cke-copybin-start="1"><span data-cke-copybin-start="1"><span data-cke-copybin-start="1">​大家好，我是<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/shenchuanchao">码农刚子</a>。</span></span></span>本文介绍了Blazor中的布局、路由和条件渲染功能。在布局方面，详细讲解了如何创建和应用布局组件（继承LayoutComponentBase），包括默认布局MainLayout的使用、嵌套布局的实现方式以及如何控制特定页面不应用布局（如登录页）。在路由和导航部分，简要提及了基本配置方法。最后，重点阐述了条件渲染（@if语句）和循环渲染（@foreach等）的语法和实际应用场景，通过学生信息列表等示例展示了数据绑定和动态UI生成的实现方式。这些核心功能共同构成了Blazor组件化开发的基础框架。
<h2 id="usefulness-of-blazor-layouts"><span id="cke_bm_11375S">&nbsp;一、创建和应用Blazor 布局</span></h2>
<p id="u007b173f">网站应用往往有许多公共的视图部分，比如顶部导航nav,底部的footer，管理系统的左边的menu菜单等等。Layout可以轻松实现以上的效果。</p>
<p id="u4fbbe142">Blazor 布局是一个 Razor 组件，它与引用该布局的组件共享标记。 布局可以使用数据绑定、依赖关系注入和组件的其他功能。</p>
<h3 id="l3xfn">1、创建布局（可以理解为母版页）</h3>
<p id="u3a9544f2">新建一个razor文件，文件顶部使用@inherits LayoutComponentBase 表示继承自LayoutComponentBase ，说明这是个母版页，使@Body作为占位。</p>
<p id="u149113dc">&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_image cke_image_nocaption cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="图像" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="118" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<p class="img-center cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22hasCaption%22%3Afalse%2C%22src%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fi-blog.csdnimg.cn%2Fimg_convert%2F17db26a2fc59811f252472259a25564c.png%22%2C%22alt%22%3A%22%22%2C%22width%22%3A954%2C%22height%22%3A486%2C%22lock%22%3Atrue%2C%22align%22%3A%22center%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-widget="image"><span class="cke_image_resizer_wrapper"><img src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/img_convert/17db26a2fc59811f252472259a25564c.png" alt="" width="954" height="486" id="aJlQO" data-cke-saved-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/img_convert/17db26a2fc59811f252472259a25564c.png" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1"><span class="cke_image_resizer" title="点击并拖拽以改变尺寸">​</span></span></p>

<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%40inherits%20LayoutComponentBase%5Cn%5Cn%3CPageTitle%3EDoctor%20Who%C2%AE%20Database%3C%2FPageTitle%3E%5Cn%5Cn%3Cheader%3E%5Cn%20%20%20%20%3Ch1%3EDoctor%20Who%C2%AE%20Database%3C%2Fh1%3E%5Cn%3C%2Fheader%3E%5Cn%5Cn%3Cnav%3E%5Cn%20%20%20%20%3Ca%20href%3D%5C%22main-list%5C%22%3EMain%20Episode%20List%3C%2Fa%3E%5Cn%20%20%20%20%3Ca%20href%3D%5C%22search%5C%22%3ESearch%3C%2Fa%3E%5Cn%20%20%20%20%3Ca%20href%3D%5C%22new%5C%22%3EAdd%20Episode%3C%2Fa%3E%5Cn%3C%2Fnav%3E%5Cn%5Cn%40Body%5Cn%5Cn%3Cfooter%3E%5Cn%20%20%20%20%40TrademarkMessage%5Cn%3C%2Ffooter%3E%5Cn%5Cn%40code%20%7B%5Cn%20%20%20%20public%20string%20TrademarkMessage%20%7B%20get%3B%20set%3B%20%7D%20%3D%5C%22CSharp%E7%B2%BE%E9%80%89%E8%90%A5%5C%22%3B%5Cn%7D%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">@inherits LayoutComponentBase

&lt;PageTitle&gt;Doctor Who® Database&lt;/PageTitle&gt;

&lt;header&gt;
    &lt;h1&gt;Doctor Who® Database&lt;/h1&gt;
&lt;/header&gt;

&lt;nav&gt;
    &lt;a href="main-list"&gt;Main Episode List&lt;/a&gt;
    &lt;a href="search"&gt;Search&lt;/a&gt;
    &lt;a href="new"&gt;Add Episode&lt;/a&gt;
&lt;/nav&gt;

@Body

&lt;footer&gt;
    @TrademarkMessage
&lt;/footer&gt;

@code {
    public string TrademarkMessage { get; set; } ="CSharp精选营";
}</code></pre>

<h3 id="woAmM">2、MainLayout 组件</h3>
<p id="u3a72bb1e">在从 Blazor 项目模板创建的应用中，<code>MainLayout</code> 组件就是应用的默认布局。</p>
<p id="u271720e9">Blazor 的 CSS 隔离功能将独立 CSS 样式应用于 <code>MainLayout</code> 组件。 按照惯例，样式由相同名称的随附样式表 <code>MainLayout.razor.css</code> 提供。</p>
<p id="u8bc4b049">&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_image cke_image_nocaption cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="图像" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="116" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">

<h3 id="WXs28">3、应用布局</h3>
<p id="ue5f9dbff">在razor文件顶部申明“@layout 模板页名”来设置母版页，</p>
<p id="ufd4b8643">&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_image cke_image_nocaption cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="图像" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="114" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<p class="img-center cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22hasCaption%22%3Afalse%2C%22src%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fi-blog.csdnimg.cn%2Fimg_convert%2Fbc1edcdda470ec5d61fc422465d5e24e.png%22%2C%22alt%22%3A%22%22%2C%22width%22%3A537%2C%22height%22%3A382%2C%22lock%22%3Atrue%2C%22align%22%3A%22center%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-widget="image"><span class="cke_image_resizer_wrapper"><img src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/img_convert/bc1edcdda470ec5d61fc422465d5e24e.png" alt="" width="537" height="382" id="ua536d46e" data-cke-saved-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/img_convert/bc1edcdda470ec5d61fc422465d5e24e.png" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1"><span class="cke_image_resizer" title="点击并拖拽以改变尺寸">​</span></span></p>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1466017/202510/1466017-20251025181716895-51938865.gif" width="15" height="15" class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler" title="点击并拖拽以移动" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1"><span class="cke_widget_edit_container" title="编辑图片">编辑</span></span></div>
<p id="u748e6fc0">如果一个页面没有设置模板页，（就像blazor默认项目那样），他就会使用在app.razor文件中定义的默认模板页</p>
<p id="uea131436">&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_image cke_image_nocaption cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="图像" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="113" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<p class="img-center cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22hasCaption%22%3Afalse%2C%22src%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fi-blog.csdnimg.cn%2Fimg_convert%2F07c69bc84df89396eb47a0f95384f6b9.png%22%2C%22alt%22%3A%22%22%2C%22width%22%3A905%2C%22height%22%3A400%2C%22lock%22%3Atrue%2C%22align%22%3A%22center%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-widget="image"><span class="cke_image_resizer_wrapper"><img src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/img_convert/07c69bc84df89396eb47a0f95384f6b9.png" alt="" width="905" height="400" id="u642d15f9" data-cke-saved-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/img_convert/07c69bc84df89396eb47a0f95384f6b9.png" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1"><span class="cke_image_resizer" title="点击并拖拽以改变尺寸">​</span></span></p>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1466017/202510/1466017-20251025181716895-51938865.gif" width="15" height="15" class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler" title="点击并拖拽以移动" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1"><span class="cke_widget_edit_container" title="编辑图片">编辑</span></span></div>
<p id="u9bbd6cf8"><strong>如何</strong><strong>不设置任何模板页?</strong></p>
<p id="uf73a9ade">比如我们的登录的页面是不需要加通用模板的，通过@if 控制 RouteView的DefaultLayout即可</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="112" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%3CRouter%20AppAssembly%3D%5C%22%40typeof(App).Assembly%5C%22%3E%5Cn%5Ct%3CFound%20Context%3D%5C%22routeData%5C%22%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%40if%20(routeData.PageType%20%3D%3D%20typeof(Pages.LayoutSample))%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%7B%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%3CRouteView%20RouteData%3D%5C%22%40routeData%5C%22%20%2F%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%7D%5Cn%5Ct%5Ctelse%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%7B%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%3CRouteView%20RouteData%3D%5C%22%40routeData%5C%22%20DefaultLayout%3D%5C%22%40typeof(MainLayout)%5C%22%20%2F%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%3CFocusOnNavigate%20RouteData%3D%5C%22%40routeData%5C%22%20Selector%3D%5C%22h1%5C%22%20%2F%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%7D%5Cn%5Ct%3C%2FFound%3E%5Cn%5Ct%3CNotFound%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%3CPageTitle%3ENot%20found%3C%2FPageTitle%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%3CLayoutView%20Layout%3D%5C%22%40typeof(MainLayout)%5C%22%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%3Cp%20role%3D%5C%22alert%5C%22%3ESorry%2C%20there's%20nothing%20at%20this%20address.%3C%2Fp%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%3C%2FLayoutView%3E%5Cn%5Ct%3C%2FNotFound%3E%5Cn%3C%2FRouter%3E%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">&lt;Router AppAssembly="@typeof(App).Assembly"&gt;
	&lt;Found Context="routeData"&gt;
		@if (routeData.PageType == typeof(Pages.LayoutSample))
		{
			&lt;RouteView RouteData="@routeData" /&gt;
		}
		else
		{
			&lt;RouteView RouteData="@routeData" DefaultLayout="@typeof(MainLayout)" /&gt;
			&lt;FocusOnNavigate RouteData="@routeData" Selector="h1" /&gt;
		}
	&lt;/Found&gt;
	&lt;NotFound&gt;
		&lt;PageTitle&gt;Not found&lt;/PageTitle&gt;
		&lt;LayoutView Layout="@typeof(MainLayout)"&gt;
			&lt;p role="alert"&gt;Sorry, there's nothing at this address.&lt;/p&gt;
		&lt;/LayoutView&gt;
	&lt;/NotFound&gt;
&lt;/Router&gt;</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1466017/202510/1466017-20251025181716895-51938865.gif" width="15" height="15" class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler" title="点击并拖拽以移动" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1"></span></div>
<h3 id="mlFgA">4、嵌套布局</h3>
<p id="u533cfefa">组件可以引用一个布局，该布局又可以引用另一个布局。 例如，嵌套布局可用于创建多级菜单结构。</p>
<p id="ua7807a50">以下示例演示如何使用嵌套布局:</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="111" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%40inherits%20LayoutComponentBase%5Cn%40layout%20ProductionsLayout%5Cn%5Cn%3CPageTitle%3EDoctor%20Who%C2%AE%20Database%3C%2FPageTitle%3E%5Cn%3Cheader%3E%5Cn%20%20%20%20%3Ch1%3EDoctor%20Who%C2%AE%20Database%3C%2Fh1%3E%5Cn%3C%2Fheader%3E%5Cn%3Cnav%3E%5Cn%20%20%20%20%3Ca%20href%3D%5C%22main-episode-list%5C%22%3EMain%20Episode%20List%3C%2Fa%3E%5Cn%20%20%20%20%3Ca%20href%3D%5C%22episode-search%5C%22%3ESearch%3C%2Fa%3E%5Cn%20%20%20%20%3Ca%20href%3D%5C%22new-episode%5C%22%3EAdd%20Episode%3C%2Fa%3E%5Cn%3C%2Fnav%3E%5Cn%5Cn%40Body%5Cn%5Cn%3Cfooter%3E%5Cn%20%20%20%20%40TrademarkMessage%5Cn%3C%2Ffooter%3E%5Cn%5Cn%40code%20%7B%5Cn%20%20%20%20public%20string%20TrademarkMessage%20%7B%20get%3B%20set%3B%20%7D%20%3D%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%5C%22CSharp%E7%B2%BE%E9%80%89%E8%90%A5%5C%22%3B%5Cn%7D%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">@inherits LayoutComponentBase
@layout ProductionsLayout

&lt;PageTitle&gt;Doctor Who® Database&lt;/PageTitle&gt;
&lt;header&gt;
    &lt;h1&gt;Doctor Who® Database&lt;/h1&gt;
&lt;/header&gt;
&lt;nav&gt;
    &lt;a href="main-episode-list"&gt;Main Episode List&lt;/a&gt;
    &lt;a href="episode-search"&gt;Search&lt;/a&gt;
    &lt;a href="new-episode"&gt;Add Episode&lt;/a&gt;
&lt;/nav&gt;

@Body

&lt;footer&gt;
    @TrademarkMessage
&lt;/footer&gt;

@code {
    public string TrademarkMessage { get; set; } =
        "CSharp精选营";
}</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1466017/202510/1466017-20251025181716895-51938865.gif" width="15" height="15" class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler" title="点击并拖拽以移动" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1"></span></div>
<p id="u972124e8"><code>ProductionsLayout</code> 组件包含顶级布局元素，其中包含有标头 (<code>&lt;header&gt;...&lt;/header&gt;</code>) 和页脚 (<code>&lt;footer&gt;...&lt;/footer&gt;</code>) 元素。 带有<code>DoctorWhoLayout</code>组件的 <code>Episodes</code> 会在<code>@Body</code>出现的位置显示。</p>

<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%40inherits%20LayoutComponentBase%5Cn%5Cn%3Cheader%3E%5Cn%20%20%20%20%3Ch1%3EProductions%3C%2Fh1%3E%5Cn%3C%2Fheader%3E%5Cn%5Cn%3Cnav%3E%5Cn%20%20%20%20%3Ca%20href%3D%5C%22main-production-list%5C%22%3EMain%20Production%20List%3C%2Fa%3E%5Cn%20%20%20%20%3Ca%20href%3D%5C%22production-search%5C%22%3ESearch%3C%2Fa%3E%5Cn%20%20%20%20%3Ca%20href%3D%5C%22new-production%5C%22%3EAdd%20Production%3C%2Fa%3E%5Cn%3C%2Fnav%3E%5Cn%5Cn%40Body%5Cn%5Cn%3Cfooter%3E%5Cn%20%20%20%20Footer%20of%20Productions%20Layout%5Cn%3C%2Ffooter%3E%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">@inherits LayoutComponentBase

<h2 id="DMRbo">二、路由配置和导航</h2>
<p id="u23040cbd"><strong>&nbsp;<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/shenchuanchao/p/19160108">ASP.NET Core Blazor 路由配置和导航 - 码农刚子 - 博客园</a></strong></p>
<h2 id="xCU8G">三、条件渲染和循环渲染</h2>
<p id="ud87fecb0">第一章中已经讲过了Blazor的语法。</p>
<h3 id="nNj26">1、Blazor 条件渲染</h3>
<p id="ue4b3785a">Blazor 中的 @if 语法用于根据条件动态渲染页面元素。它类似于 C# 的 if 语句，但专门用于处理 UI 渲染。请看以下示例：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="104" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%40if%20(isLoading)%5Cn%7B%5Cn%20%20%20%3Cp%3E%E5%8A%A0%E8%BD%BD%E4%B8%AD...%3C%2Fp%3E%5Cn%7D%5Cnelse%5Cn%7B%5Cn%20%20%20%3Cp%3E%E5%8A%A0%E8%BD%BD%E5%AE%8C%E6%88%90%EF%BC%81%3C%2Fp%3E%5Cn%7D%5Cn%40code%20%7B%5Cn%20%20%20private%20bool%20isLoading%20%3D%20true%3B%5Cn%20%20%20protected%20override%20void%20OnInitialized()%5Cn%20%20%20%7B%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%2F%2F%20%E6%A8%A1%E6%8B%9F%E5%8A%A0%E8%BD%BD%E5%AE%8C%E6%88%90%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20Task.Delay(2000).ContinueWith(_%20%3D%3E%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%7B%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20isLoading%20%3D%20false%3B%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged)%3B%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%7D)%3B%5Cn%20%20%20%7D%5Cn%7D%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">@if (isLoading)
{
   &lt;p&gt;加载中...&lt;/p&gt;
}
else
{
   &lt;p&gt;加载完成！&lt;/p&gt;
}
@code {
   private bool isLoading = true;
   protected override void OnInitialized()
   {
       // 模拟加载完成
       Task.Delay(2000).ContinueWith(_ =&gt;
       {
           isLoading = false;
           InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
       });
   }
}</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1466017/202510/1466017-20251025181716895-51938865.gif" width="15" height="15" class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler" title="点击并拖拽以移动" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1"></span></div>
<p id="ub9d66459">你可以嵌套多个 @if 或结合 else if 使用：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="103" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%40if%20(userRole%20%3D%3D%20%5C%22Admin%5C%22)%5Cn%7B%5Cn%20%20%20%3Cp%3E%E6%AC%A2%E8%BF%8E%E7%AE%A1%E7%90%86%E5%91%98%EF%BC%81%3C%2Fp%3E%5Cn%7D%5Cnelse%20if%20(userRole%20%3D%3D%20%5C%22User%5C%22)%5Cn%7B%5Cn%20%20%20%3Cp%3E%E6%AC%A2%E8%BF%8E%E6%99%AE%E9%80%9A%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%EF%BC%81%3C%2Fp%3E%5Cn%7D%5Cnelse%5Cn%7B%5Cn%20%20%20%3Cp%3E%E8%AF%B7%E7%99%BB%E5%BD%95%E3%80%82%3C%2Fp%3E%5Cn%7D%5Cn%40code%20%7B%5Cn%20%20%20private%20string%20userRole%20%3D%20%5C%22Admin%5C%22%3B%5Cn%7D%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">@if (userRole == "Admin")
{
   &lt;p&gt;欢迎管理员！&lt;/p&gt;
}
else if (userRole == "User")
{
   &lt;p&gt;欢迎普通用户！&lt;/p&gt;
}
else
{
   &lt;p&gt;请登录。&lt;/p&gt;
}
@code {
   private string userRole = "Admin";
}</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1466017/202510/1466017-20251025181716895-51938865.gif" width="15" height="15" class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler" title="点击并拖拽以移动" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1"></span></div>
<h3 id="oi8eU">2、Blazor 循环渲染</h3>
<p id="ua333332d">下面我们有一个list需要显示多个学生信息,@for,@do…while,@while 与foreach类似这里就不在赘述</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="102" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%3Ch3%3E%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E5%88%97%E8%A1%A8%3C%2Fh3%3E%5Cn%5Cn%3Ctable%3E%5Cn%5Ct%3Cthead%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%3Ctr%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%3Cth%3EName%3C%2Fth%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%3Cth%3EAge%3C%2Fth%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%3Cth%3EGender%3C%2Fth%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%3C%2Ftr%3E%5Cn%5Ct%3C%2Fthead%3E%5Cn%5Ct%3Ctbody%3E%5Cn%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%40foreach%20(var%20item%20in%20list)%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%7B%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%3Ctr%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%3Ctd%3E%40item.Name%3C%2Ftd%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%3Ctd%3E%40item.Age%3C%2Ftd%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%40switch%20(item.Gender)%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%7B%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ctcase%200%3A%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%7B%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%3Ctd%3E%E7%94%B7%3C%2Ftd%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ctbreak%3B%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%7D%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ctcase%201%3A%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%7B%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%3Ctd%3E%E5%A5%B3%3C%2Ftd%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ctbreak%3B%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%7D%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ctcase%202%3A%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%7B%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%3Ctd%3E%E6%9C%AA%E7%9F%A5%3C%2Ftd%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ctbreak%3B%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%7D%5Cn%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%7D%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Ct%3C%2Ftr%3E%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%7D%5Cn%5Ct%3C%2Ftbody%3E%5Cn%5Cn%3C%2Ftable%3E%5Cn%5Cn%5Cn%40code%20%7B%5Cn%5CtList%3CUser%3E%20list%20%3D%20new%20List%3CUser%3E()%3B%5Cn%5CtUser%20User1%20%3D%20new%20User()%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%7B%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5CtName%20%3D%20%5C%22John%5C%22%2C%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5CtAge%20%3D%2020%2C%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5CtGender%20%3D%202%2C%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%7D%3B%5Cn%5CtUser%20User2%20%3D%20new%20User()%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%7B%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5CtName%20%3D%20%5C%22Sub%5C%22%2C%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5CtAge%20%3D%2022%2C%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5CtGender%20%3D%200%2C%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%7D%3B%5Cn%5Ctprotected%20override%20void%20OnInitialized()%5Cn%5Ct%7B%5Cn%5Ct%5Ctlist.Add(User1)%3B%5Cn%5Ct%5Ctlist.Add(User2)%3B%5Cn%5Ct%7D%5Cn%5Cn%5Ctpublic%20class%20User%5Cn%5Ct%7B%5Cn%5Ct%5Ctpublic%20string%20Name%20%7B%20get%3B%20set%3B%20%7D%20%3D%20string.Empty%3B%5Cn%5Ct%5Ctpublic%20int%20Age%20%7B%20get%3B%20set%3B%20%7D%5Cn%5Ct%5Ctpublic%20int%20Gender%20%7B%20get%3B%20set%3B%20%7D%20%2F%2F%200%3A%20%E7%94%B7%2C%201%3A%20%E5%A5%B3%2C%202%3A%20%E6%9C%AA%E7%9F%A5%5Cn%5Ct%5Ct%5Cn%5Ct%7D%5Cn%7D%5Cn%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">&lt;h3&gt;用户列表&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;table&gt;
	&lt;thead&gt;
		&lt;tr&gt;
			&lt;th&gt;Name&lt;/th&gt;
			&lt;th&gt;Age&lt;/th&gt;
			&lt;th&gt;Gender&lt;/th&gt;
		&lt;/tr&gt;
	&lt;/thead&gt;
	&lt;tbody&gt;

		@foreach (var item in list)
		{
			&lt;tr&gt;
				&lt;td&gt;@item.Name&lt;/td&gt;
				&lt;td&gt;@item.Age&lt;/td&gt;
				@switch (item.Gender)
				{
					case 0:
						{
							&lt;td&gt;男&lt;/td&gt;
							break;
						}
					case 1:
						{
							&lt;td&gt;女&lt;/td&gt;
							break;
						}
					case 2:
						{
							&lt;td&gt;未知&lt;/td&gt;
							break;
						}

				}
			&lt;/tr&gt;
		}
	&lt;/tbody&gt;

&lt;/table&gt;


@code {
	List&lt;User&gt; list = new List&lt;User&gt;();
	User User1 = new User()
		{
			Name = "John",
			Age = 20,
			Gender = 2,
		};
	User User2 = new User()
		{
			Name = "Sub",
			Age = 22,
			Gender = 0,
		};
	protected override void OnInitialized()
	{
		list.Add(User1);
		list.Add(User2);
	}

	public class User
	{
		public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
		public int Age { get; set; }
		public int Gender { get; set; } // 0: 男, 1: 女, 2: 未知
		
	}
}
</code></pre>
